title: Bach: The Goldberg Variations - Glen Gould Music CD CBS Records Masterworks
descriptionText: The product is a music CD titled "Bach: The Goldberg Variations" by Glenn Gould, featuring instrumental classical music composed by Johann Sebastian Bach. Released by CBS Records under the Masterworks label in 1990, this album showcases Bach's renowned "Goldberg Variations" in a multicolor CD format. With its high-quality sound and artistic presentation, this CD offers fans of classical music an immersive listening experience of one of Bach's most celebrated works.
